registered_by: lead session, from the team lead's 10/15 04:1x approval of the proposed criteria and S2-RESULT-PLAN.md

arms.B: ideal simulated height map, 187 rays, validity mask, 374 columns

evaluation.pairing: same terrain, same seed, same command, A versus B

decision_rules.map_is_good: for each target layer (gap, stepping_stones): lower bound of the 95% Tango paired confidence interval of (B - A) success > 0 AND mean difference >= 10 percentage points
decision_rules.unclear: interval includes 0 or mean difference < 10 percentage points; reported as unclear, not as no effect
decision_rules.regression_watch: flat and stairs_up: B must not be worse than A beyond the interval
decision_rules.no_selective_repetition: a low or negative result is a valid negative result; no repeated runs until a good result appears

claim_limits: training encounter log is empty in the current entry; map effect is read only from checkpoint evaluation
performance_verified stays false until the evaluator is verified in real Kit
N, updates and seeds are fixed for both arms
